tasks.completion_summary: Slice A: session pgid tracked and killed on cleanup; three follow-up subtasks created for slices B/C/D
Slice B: daemon startup now scans /proc for orphaned pgids (leader dead, members alive, uid-filtered) and reaps them via Slice A primitives; gated by session.orphan-pgid-scan config

Slice D: Session Containment section added to daemon-architecture.md, CLAUDE.md constraint note, end-to-end port-reuse repro + setsid-escape negative test via TestMain self-exec portholder. All tests green under -race.

Slice C: Windows Job Object containment for session cleanup. platform.{CreateSessionJobObject,AssignProcessToSessionJob,AssignPIDToSessionJob,KillSessionJobObject} with Unix stub. SessionJobHandle wired through protocol/daemon/client/run_windows.go. Daemon cleanup calls both KillSessionPGID and KillSessionJobObject — each no-ops on the wrong platform. Pre-existing vendor bug in go-cli-server (findAllDescendants) plus Slice B orphan_pgid missing build tag block full Windows cross-compile of daemon; platform package builds and tests compile cleanly for windows/amd64. Windows runtime validation pending — tested via cross-compile only.
